warning: SIMULATED DATA - not real survey responses or measurements

assumptions.sample: 160 Mérida households + 100 relatives in 10 other states (Google Forms style).
assumptions.merida_zones: Weights norte .30, sur .20, oriente .17, poniente .18, centro .15. NO systematic difference between zones is simulated: any zone gap in this data is random noise.
assumptions.drinking_source: Peninsula (Mérida, Campeche, Q. Roo): garrafón .78, filtro .10, hervida .04, llave .05, otro .03. Other states: garrafón .62, filtro .16, hervida .08, llave .12, otro .02.
assumptions.garrafones_per_week: Only for garrafón users: Poisson with mean 0.55 x people in the home (min 1).
assumptions.garrafon_price: Peninsula 32 MXN per 20 L refill, other states 38 MXN (assumed refill-station prices).
assumptions.consumption: Water use per home = 4.2 m3 per person per month x lognormal noise (sd 0.35).
assumptions.bill: Monthly bill = consumption x (0.55 x commercial tariff of the state capital) + 35 MXN fixed charge, x lognormal noise (sd 0.25). Domestic tariff assumed 55% of the commercial one.
assumptions.outages: Probabilities (nunca, 1-2 veces, cada mes, cada semana) depend on the regional water stress: <35% -> (.45,.38,.12,.05); 35-80% -> (.28,.40,.21,.11); >80% -> (.15,.33,.30,.22).
assumptions.septic_detail: Homes with septic drainage split into fosa séptica .68, pozo/sumidero .17, biodigestor .10, no sé .05. Peninsula homes 'no sé' adds .04 to sewer answers (people unsure).
assumptions.septic_emptying: (nunca, cada 1-2 años, más de 2 años, no sé) = (.30,.18,.27,.25).
assumptions.trust_tap: Trust in tap water 1-5: peninsula mean 1.9, other states 2.4 (normal sd 1, rounded, clipped).
assumptions.scale_marks: Probability of noticing scale (sarro): peninsula .86, Nuevo León/Chihuahua/Sonora .62, others .48.
assumptions.water_tests: 5 Mérida zones x 3 tap replicates + 3 bottled samples x 3 replicates. Meter TDS = 0.5 x conductivity (typical meter factor). Zone means drawn at random around the RENAMECA median (sd 90 ppm). Strip readings are rounded to the nearest strip pad. Bottled water: TDS 15-150 ppm, hardness 0-50, nitrate 0-10 (assumed reverse-osmosis water).
